en.topic_title: Officers lack power to order identity proof under police ordinance, court hears as Ronson Chan seeks top court appeal

zh.topic_title: Officers lack power to order identity proof under police ordinance, court hears as Ronson Chan seeks top court appeal

en.topic_title: Officers lack power to order identity proof under police ordinance, court hears as Ronson Chan seeks top court appeal
en.topic_summary:
The police ordinance does not empower officers to demand identity proof, a lawyer for Ronson Chan has argued as the former head of Hong Kong’s largest press union applied to challenge his conviction for obstructing police at the Court of Final Appeal.



Ronson Chan on May 16, 2023. Photo: Lea Mok/HKFP.



Ronson Chan, who helmed the Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) from 2021 to 2024, applied to the High Court on Wednesday for permission to take his challenge to the top court.
